title: Telemetry facet extractor and safe sample replayer
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Adds a lightweight telemetry facet extractor for compact on-call snapshots and a safe sample replayer CLI for reproducible, permissioned replay of representative traces. No breaking API changes.
description: Motivation: On-call engineers frequently need small, deterministic telemetry slices that capture the relevant signal for an alert without exposing full traces or large payloads. This PR introduces two complementary utilities: (1) telemetry-facet-extractor, a server-side tool that converts a raw telemetry window into a small set of 'facets' (aggregates, top-k traces, fingerprinted spans) suitable for quick on-call triage; and (2) safe-sample-replayer, a CLI that replays a curated, redacted sample into a local sandbox for repro and debugging. Both components are designed to be safe by default (automatic redaction, sampling budget, permission checks) and configurable for SRE workflows. Changes include a new extractor service module, a lightweight replay CLI, schema extensions for facet metadata, unit and integration tests, and docs with recommended on-call workflows.

b3d7e1f implement fingerprint-based span summarizer and top-k selection
c4f8a77 add CLI for safe sample replayer with permission gating
d11a4b2 redact sensitive fields in extractor output and add schema v1.1
e5a2f90 update docs and add canary CI integration tests
diff_summary: ~120 lines added across extractor, CLI and tests; schema file added; docs updated with usage examples and safety notes. Key changes: new facet_extractor module (core algorithm ~220 LOC), safe_replay CLI (80 LOC), redaction rules JSON (30 LOC).
testing_summary: Unit tests cover facet selection heuristics and redaction rules. Integration test spins up a small synthetic telemetry stream and validates replay fidelity and permission enforcement. Added a lightweight canary job for nightly runs.
backwards_compatibility: No breaking changes to existing public SLO toolkit APIs. Facet schema is additive (v1.1) and older clients ignore new metadata fields. CLI is opt-in and does not change server behavior by default.
rollout_plan: Canary rollout on staging via helm values toggle (charts/slo-toolkit/values.yaml) for 48 hours, collect feedback, then gradual rollout to prod with feature flag. Operators can opt-out of replay capability via RBAC policies in ops/permissions.
security_considerations: Extractor applies automatic redaction rules and a sampling budget to avoid overexposure. Replay CLI requires scoped token with 'slo.replay' permission and enforces an audit log entry for every replay. Redaction rules are configurable and reviewed by security. SUP-1102 tracks follow-up audit logging enhancement.

Ava Martinez: Switched to default redact-all-identifiers behavior and added an allowlist mechanism controlled by an environment variable and Helm value. Updated docs to warn about the change.
Marcus Chen: Integration tests flaked once on CI due to timeouts; increased test timeouts and added retry for the canary job. Verified locally. Approving pending CI.
Jun Park: Approved. Marked for squash-merge after CI passes.
post_merge_actions: Added helm values toggle to docs and notified SRE channel with rollout instructions. Created ENG-4431 follow-up to add replay audit aggregator dashboard.
notes: This PR aims to reduce on-call cognitive load by surfacing minimal, high-signal telemetry facets and giving engineers a safe way to reproduce issues locally. The extractor's heuristics are intentionally conservative to prioritize safety over completeness.
